products.name: 3PCS Glass Storage Jar Set,  880+1400+1700ML Color Box Packing
products.description:
This 3PCS Glass Storage Jar Set is designed for everyday kitchen storage with both style and practicality. The set includes three jars with capacities of 880ml, 1400ml, and 1700ml, making it perfect for storing a variety of dry items such as rice, pulses, snacks, sugar, coffee, tea, and spices.

Made from high-quality transparent glass, these jars allow easy visibility of contents, helping you stay organized and avoid wastage. The jars are sturdy, easy to clean, and safe for regular use. Each jar comes with a secure-fitting lid that helps protect contents from moisture and dust.

Packed neatly in a color box, this set is ideal for personal use as well as gifting. A perfect blend of utility, durability, and elegant kitchen aesthetics.
products.shortDescription: 3-piece premium glass storage jar set (880ml, 1400ml, 1700ml) with durable transparent glass and secure lids. Ideal for storing dry foods. Comes in attractive color box packing.

products.name: Plastic Helmet (Industrial)
products.description:
The Plastic Helmet is a lightweight and durable head protection solution designed for everyday safety needs. Made from high-quality plastic material, it offers basic impact resistance while remaining comfortable for extended wear.

Its ergonomic design ensures a secure and stable fit, making it suitable for use in construction sites, factories, workshops, events, or general safety environments. The helmet is easy to wear, easy to maintain, and built for regular use without causing discomfort.

With its sturdy construction and practical design, this plastic helmet is a reliable and cost-effective choice for ensuring essential head protection.
products.shortDescription: Lightweight plastic helmet designed for basic head protection. Durable build with comfortable fit, suitable for general safety and utility purposes.

products.name: 3-piece condiments jar set with stand
products.description:
The 3PCS Condiments Jar with Stand is a stylish and practical solution for organizing everyday kitchen essentials. This set includes three jars with capacities of 150ml and 270ml, ideal for storing spices, pickles, sauces, chutneys, or seasonings.

Designed in a modern white and grey color combination, the jars enhance kitchen aesthetics while keeping contents easily accessible. The durable stand ensures stability and neat arrangement on countertops or dining tables.

Made for convenience and daily use, the jars are easy to clean and maintain. Packed in an attractive color box, this set is suitable for home use as well as gifting. A perfect blend of functionality, organization, and contemporary kitchen style.
products.shortDescription: 3-piece condiments jar set with stand, featuring 150ml and 270ml jars. Elegant white and grey design with sturdy stand. Comes in color box packing.

products.name: Reflective Vest (Safety Jacket)
products.description:
The Reflective Vest is designed to improve safety by ensuring high visibility in low-light and hazardous environments. Made from lightweight and breathable material, it provides comfort even during long working hours.

The vest features reflective strips that clearly reflect light from vehicles and surroundings, making the wearer easily noticeable at night or in poor visibility conditions. It can be worn over regular clothing and allows free movement without restriction.

Ideal for construction workers, road safety staff, warehouse workers, cyclists, delivery personnel, and event crews, this reflective vest is a simple yet essential safety accessory for everyday use.
products.shortDescription: High-visibility reflective safety vest for enhanced visibility in low-light conditions. Lightweight, comfortable, and easy to wear.

products.name: 4 Layer Plastic Storage Box with Wheels (59×40×92 cm)
products.description:
The 4 Layer Plastic Storage Box with Wheels is a practical and space-efficient storage solution designed for modern homes and workplaces. With a size of 59 × 40 × 92 cm, it offers ample storage across four spacious layers, making it ideal for organizing clothes, toys, books, kitchen items, office supplies, or accessories.

Made from durable, high-quality plastic, the storage box is built for long-term everyday use. The smooth-rolling wheels allow easy movement, enabling you to reposition the unit effortlessly without lifting. Featuring a 3–4 color mixed design, it adds a neat and pleasant look to any room.

This storage unit helps reduce clutter while keeping items easily accessible. Suitable for bedrooms, living rooms, kitchens, offices, and storerooms. A perfect combination of functionality, mobility, and modern storage design.
products.shortDescription: 4-layer plastic storage box with smooth-rolling wheels, spacious design, and mixed color finish. Ideal for organized home and office storage.

products.description:
The 5 Layer Metal Storage Box with Wheels – White is a durable and efficient storage solution designed for organized living and working spaces. Built with strong metal construction, it offers enhanced strength and long-lasting performance compared to plastic storage units.

products.name: Melamine Fish Plate – 35 cm
products.description:
The Melamine Fish Plate – 35 cm is specially designed for serving fish and seafood dishes with style and convenience. Made from high-quality melamine material, the plate is durable, lightweight, and resistant to breakage, making it suitable for regular use.

With a 35 cm size, it offers ample space for serving whole fish or large portions. Available in many color options, with one color per carton, ensuring uniformity for bulk orders. The smooth surface allows easy cleaning and long-lasting use.

Ideal for homes, restaurants, hotels, catering services, and commercial kitchens, this fish plate combines functionality, durability, and attractive presentation.
products.shortDescription: 35 cm melamine fish plate available in multiple colors. Durable, lightweight, and ideal for serving fish dishes. One color per carton.
